name: walmart-mcp
description: Walmart Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listin

platform_mcp_walmart_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_walmart_client_id.description: Walmart Marketplace API Client ID (Seller Center > Settings > API Key Management / Developer Portal, production keys).

platform_mcp_walmart_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_walmart_client_secret.description: The matching Client Secret; sent only as HTTP Basic to POST /v3/token, which returns a 15-minute access token sent as WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN.

platform_mcp_walmart_ship_node.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_SHIP_NODE
platform_mcp_walmart_ship_node.description: shipNode id for set_inventory when you have several ship nodes; empty = your default ship node.

platform_mcp_walmart_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_ENV
platform_mcp_walmart_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://sandbox.walmartapis.com; sandbox_dynamic = https://sandbox.walmartapis.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_walmart_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_walmart_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Token detail: expiry, validity and the scopes (orders, item, price, inventory…) granted to these API keys.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: All orders (last 180 days, seller-fulfilled): `since` = createdStartDate (ISO date/datetime; Walmart's default is 7 days ago); `status` = Created, Acknowledged, Shipped, Delivered or Cancelled (a purchase-order LINE status). Up to 200 per call; Walmart pages with an opaque list.meta.nextCursor query string (kept under raw), not page numbers, so narrow with `since` instead of `page`. orderDate and line details are in raw (orderDate is epoch ms).

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Update a price: sets the BASE price (USD) of one SKU (listing_id = your seller SKU). Only `price` is applied (required); title/description go through the item feed and stock through set_inventory. Allow up to five minutes to reach walmart.com.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: Update inventory for one item: `sku` (your seller SKU) is required; the quantity is set in EACH at the configured shipNode (or your default ship node).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Retire an item (listing_id = seller SKU): "it can take up to 48 hours for items to be retired from our catalog"; to sell it again the item must be set up anew.
